base-5bit.review: Red sphere left, blue cube right, yellow pyramid between them; composition preserved relative to the R9700 5bit image. Small surface/edge differences and visible tile seams. No new severe structural defect observed. Pixel hashes differ; not a numerical equivalence claim.

turbo-5bit.review: Red sphere left, blue cube right, yellow pyramid between them; composition preserved relative to the R9700 5bit image. Small surface/edge differences and visible tile seams. No new severe structural defect observed. Pixel hashes differ; not a numerical equivalence claim.

turbo-3bit.review: Red sphere left, blue cube right, yellow pyramid between them, closely matching the R9700 3bit composition. Small surface differences and visible tile seams; no new severe structural defect observed. Not a pixel-equivalence claim.

turbo-4bit-multi-ref.review: White-sailed red toy boat in the foreground, red sphere at left, blue cube at right; close to the R9700 4bit output. Gray background differs from the blue fabric in BF16, as already observed on R9700. Small surface and tile-seam differences; no new severe structural defect observed.
